newsitem.title: UK: UK poll puts opposition Labour 25 pts ahead.
newsitem.headline: UK poll puts opposition Labour 25 pts ahead.

text.p: Britain's opposition Labour party has maintained its large lead over the ruling Conservatives in the run-up to a general election, and are now 25 points ahead, according to an opinion poll in Friday's Independent newspaper.

The Harris poll showed support for Labour had dropped one point to 52 percent from its most recent poll, carried out last week. The Conservatives dropped three points to 27 percent while the minority Liberal Democrats rose four points to 14 percent.
A poll released by polling group Opinion Research Business on Thursday showed Labour had widened its lead to 24 percentage points from 19 in the firm's previous poll two months ago.
Support for Labour, in opposition since 1979, rose to 53 percent from 51, while backing for the Conservatives slipped to 29 percent from 32.

Prime Minister John Major earlier dampened speculation that he was about to announce the date of the next election, which must be held by May 22. Most politicians expect voting to take place on May 1.
